Process Dust Model Data

process_obj.Rd

Transforms a multi-dimensional dust model output array into a long-format data.table, assigning appropriate names to dimensions and unpacking by particle if needed.

Usage

process_obj(
  this_obj,
  present_dimensions,
  colnames,
  time_length,
  x,
  model_system,
  dimension_names,
  dust_state
)

Arguments

this_obj

The model output array to process.

present_dimensions

Character vector of dimension labels for this state (e.g., `c("age", "vaccination", "risk", "time")`).

colnames

Column names for the output data table.

time_length

Length of the time dimension.

x

Index of the current state in the model.

model_system

The model system object containing metadata like number of particles.

dimension_names

Named list of dimension label values for each dimension.

dust_state

List of all unpacked model state arrays.

Value

A list of two `data.table`s: the full stratified long-format output and a reduced time-by-state (and optionally run) aggregation.
